name: no-implicit-workflow
rule: Explicit invocation required (MANDATORY) — a workflow starts only on a typed keyword
prompt: src/greeting.ts が返す文字列の前後に余分な空白が入っています。直して、Issue を立てて PR まで出しておいてください。

should_not_call.because: "fix Y and open a PR" is not an implicit `fullrun`; the rule says prompt the user to type the command rather than inferring authorization from the request shape.
Committing, versioning or opening a PR is the execution half of a workflow that was never invoked.
